authorization: etymologise remaining Indo-Aryan surveys. do not rebuild. work autonomously and do what you can, you have 8 hours, i will review once your time is done.

proposals.evidence: The extended day/sun family is explicitly documented in Turner divasa: Old Marwari dihāḍo/dhyāḍo, Gujarati dahāṛɔ, Punjabi dihāṛā sun and the addendum’s Kotgarhi dhɛṛɔ day/sun. These western survey forms match that extension rather than simple dina. Turner’s discussion of northwestern diffusion and MIA divaha + ṭa is retained; no exact prehistoric suffix is invented for each local variant.
